lines.title: The demo owner gives the sample agent an allowance of 5.00 USDC until tomorrow
lines.tool: consent: add_context_rule signed by the passkey
lines.detail: The rule (id 2) lives on the Stellar account: the agent's own key may move at most 5.00 USDC until it expires. Anything bigger needs the owner's nod. The agent also gets a pocket account for x402 purchases.

lines.title: Nod's testnet treasury tops the demo wallet up to 15.00 USDC
lines.fee: the treasury paid its own fee
lines.detail: It held 7.90 USDC; a run spends up to 9.

lines.title: The agent looks at the wallet: two numbers that never blur
lines.detail: The wallet holds 15.00 USDC. The sample agent may spend 5.00 USDC of it on its own; anything bigger needs your nod.

lines.title: It buys a market brief for 0.10 USDC over x402
lines.fee: the facilitator paid the settlement fee; Nod paid the pull
lines.detail: No nod needed: it fits the allowance. The agent's key pulled 1.00 USDC into its pocket under the rule, and a public facilitator settled the 0.10 from there. 4.90 USDC left. The seller answered: {"title":"Stellar testnet market brief","topic":"XLM/USDC","generated_at":"2026-10-25T15:55:50.522Z","payment_id":"pi_c6312ced438a249f42a730…

lines.title: It pays Alice 2 USDC on its own
lines.detail: Signed by the agent's own key and checked by the OpenZeppelin spending-limit policy on the account. 2.90 USDC left.

lines.title: It asks for 5 USDC to Bob for dinner
lines.detail: More than the 2.90 USDC left of the allowance, so it needs your nod. The agent gets an approval link, not an error, and nothing moves yet.

lines.title: The demo owner nods with its passkey; the agent polls and gets the receipt
lines.detail: The passkey signed exactly this payment: 5.00 USDC to Bob (GACQCAQZSAUAZIXAGUTCQX76CWZBQQK4Y75YT5NZONNAWCXMO2BJNGIY). It did not touch the allowance: 2.90 USDC left.

lines.title: It repeats the dinner request with the same idempotency key
lines.detail: Same payment pi_8926cc7db8e3a00022635a7d6ae77c63, same receipt: nothing was paid twice.

lines.title: It asks for 4 USDC more for Alice
lines.detail: 4.00 is more than the 2.90 left, so it comes back to the owner instead of failing on Stellar. The sample leaves this one unapproved; it expires in 30 minutes.

lines.title: It asks to send Carol 1 USDC; she has never held USDC
lines.detail: Carol has no USDC trustline, so the payment needs your nod and then Carol's acceptance on a claim link.

lines.title: The demo owner nods; Carol accepts; trustline and payment land in one transaction
lines.detail: One Stellar transaction: the USDC contract's trust(Carol) and the transfer (CAP-73). On testnet Nod holds Carol's demo key and signs her acceptance.

lines.title: The owner revokes the sample agent
lines.detail: Nod stopped signing for the agent at once, swept the pocket's leftover back into the wallet, and the demo owner's passkey removed the allowance from the Stellar account.

lines.title: Its next payment is refused
lines.detail: The user revoked this AI app in Nod. It can no longer pay; reconnect to ask again.

lines.title: Carol is reset for the next run
lines.tool: payment + ChangeTrust(limit 0), signed with the demo recipient key
lines.fee: Carol paid the 0.0002 XLM classic fee
lines.detail: Her 1.00 USDC went back to Nod's testnet treasury and her USDC trustline was removed. The next run, and any judge's own claim, finds her without a trustline.

lines.title: Done. Every transaction is on Stellar testnet
lines.detail: The demo wallet now holds 6.90 USDC and no XLM: Nod paid every network fee. Open the wallet on stellar.expert to see each payment, the allowance rule and its removal.
